help.title: Help & support
help.subtitle: We're all members here — how can we help?
help.quickPathNote: For an emergency, tap SOS on the home screen — every available worker is alerted instantly.

booking.q: How do I book a service?
booking.a: From the home screen, tap a category or search for a worker. Pick a date, time and duration (hours), review the price, then confirm. The worker accepts, and the job starts as Ongoing with live tracking.

cancel.a: Yes. Before a worker starts, you can cancel from the booking details screen. If you need help cancelling, message the worker or talk to support.

payment.a: You pay the agreed hourly rate after the job. An 8% cooperative fee on top goes to worker insurance and welfare — not platform profit.

reschedule.a: Yes — message the worker in the chat thread and agree on a new time together. You can update the slot before the worker starts.

emergency.q: What happens if I press SOS?
emergency.a: Your location and emergency are broadcast to every available worker on the board. The first worker to respond is alerted with a ringing call overlay and heads to you.

membership.q: What does it mean to be a member?
membership.a: Sahkar Sathi is member-owned. Every booking supports the worker's cooperative — fair wages, insurance and welfare, so helpers aren't just gig workers.
